name: bt_reset
sql: delete from ten280_bot.alerts where mode = 'backtest'; select 1 ok

name: bt5
sql: select ten280_bot.load_ticks(now() - interval '14 days', now()) ticks, ten280_bot.scan(now() - interval '7 days', now(), 5, 'backtest', 'bt5') alerts, now() - interval '7 days' win_from, now() win_to

name: bt7
sql: select ten280_bot.load_ticks(now() - interval '14 days', now()) ticks, ten280_bot.scan(now() - interval '7 days', now(), 7, 'backtest', 'bt7') alerts

name: bt10
sql: select ten280_bot.load_ticks(now() - interval '14 days', now()) ticks, ten280_bot.scan(now() - interval '7 days', now(), 10, 'backtest', 'bt10') alerts

name: sum_by_tier
sql: select run_id, tier, count(*) alerts, count(distinct fixture_id) matches, min(eval_at) first_alert, max(eval_at) last_alert, round(avg(pct_10m),2) avg_pct, sum(case when open_is_opener then 1 else 0 end) opened_labels from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: sum_by_day
sql: select run_id, date_trunc('day', eval_at) d, count(*) alerts, count(distinct fixture_id) matches from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: pct_dist
sql: select run_id, width_bucket(pct_10m, 5, 30, 5) b, count(*) from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: samples_bt5
sql: select eval_at, tier, pct_10m, ref_at, cur_at, message from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' and run_id='bt5' order by pct_10m desc limit 12

name: denominators
sql: with t as (select f.league_id, o.fixture_id, o.side_id, count(distinct o.price_decimal) np from public.kibl_line_observations o join public.kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where o.feed_source_id=171 and o.market_type_id=1 and o.segment_id=1 and o.betting_type_id=1 and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01 and o.side_id in (2,3) and f.league_id in (19,537,962) and f.player1_name is not null and o.inserted_on > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1,2,3) select ten280_bot.tier_of(league_id) tier, count(distinct fixture_id) matches_priced, count(distinct fixture_id) filter (where np >= 2) matches_with_a_move from t group by 1 order by 1

name: stream_denominators
sql: select ten280_bot.tier_of(f.league_id) tier, count(distinct h.fixture_id) matches, min(h.kibl_inserted_on) first_at from public.kibl_now_history h join public.kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where h.kibl_inserted_on > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1

name: capture_lag
sql: select ten280_bot.tier_of(f.league_id) tier, count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9,0.99]) within group (order by extract(epoch from (o.observed_at - o.inserted_on))) lag_s from public.kibl_line_observations o join public.kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where o.feed_source_id=171 and o.market_type_id=1 and o.segment_id=1 and o.betting_type_id=1 and o.is_live is false and o.price_decimal >= 1.01 and o.inserted_on > now() - interval '7 days' and f.league_id in (19,537,962) group by 1 order by 1

name: stream_lag
sql: select count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9,0.99]) within group (order by extract(epoch from (written_at - kibl_inserted_on))) lag_s from public.kibl_now_history where source='stream'

name: rowkey_overlap
sql: select count(*) stream_rows, count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.kibl_line_observations o where o.row_key = h.row_key)) also_in_poller from public.kibl_now_history h

name: alerts_by_src
sql: select run_id, count(*) from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='backtest' group by 1 order by 1
